term: maximal in a selected perfection, greatest degree, and maxime ens
resolution: The case uses the weakest sense: maximal in being, nothing being more a being (`IsMaximumIn InAct MoreIn esse`). It does not assume a strict maximum that exceeds every other being, and it does not use Anselm's conceptual description. Uniqueness is derived (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-AT-MOST-ONE-MAXIME-ENS), not built in. A reviewer who reads 'maxime ens' as 'the greatest possible being' is reading a stronger sense than any premise asserts. Source-attribution correction2026-11-01: AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-MAXIMUM-CAUSES-GENUS-A now supports STMT-GREATEST-DEGREE-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS, using DEF-GREATEST-DEGREE-IN-A-PERFECTION. It does not support the old unrestricted maximality principle I or its fixed-esse instance Iesse. Greatest represented degree allows ties without strict supremacy or uniqueness. The weak maximal abstraction can preserve a weaker existential consequence of greatestness under an appropriate order interpretation (as with H); putting it in an implication antecedent instead strengthens the causal conditional. No old definition, proof premise or formal consequence changes, and no totality or source-to-old-I bridge is supplied. MaximumDefinitionFork registers exact conditional bridges: selected-perfection active-pair strict degree calibration plus local directedness and explicit excluded middle imply maximal-to-greatest, which with the unchanged greatest-degree causal principle yields the exact old selected-esse causal premise. This does not make the old stronger conditional directly sourced. Primitive superlative calibrations distinguish merely maximal, greatest with ties and strict supremacy; named coverage remains OPEN with a selective-tie remainder. Finite incomparable controls block automatic source-to-old-I transfer; tied controls block uniqueness. No global homogeneous being scale is assumed. General-perfection scope: DEF-MAXIMUM-IN-A-PERFECTION quantifies at a supplied respect r; maxime ens specializes r to esse. Reuse the same distinction for general maximality and GreatestDegreeBearer, holding the active domain and selected respect fixed. MoreIn need not represent an order or a degree comparison; the #1141 calibration/directedness bridges and finite countermodels are essential, not implicit in the words maximum or greatest.
